caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically-oriented, metallic lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top. The lantern is rendered in shades of gray on a plain, off-white background. The body of the lantern features evenly spaced, decorative punchwork patterns consisting of dots and lines arranged in geometric and radial motifs, with symmetrical cross- and star-like shapes prominently visible. There is a rectangular, hinged door on the front, distinguished by a visible seam and a latch on the left side. The conical top extends upward, terminating in a looped handle for carrying or hanging the lantern. The shaded rendering emphasizes the three-dimensional form and metallic texture of the object, with subtle tonal transitions indicating the curvature of its surfaces and the depth of the punchwork. There are faint discolorations and minimal markings on the surface of the background paper, and the artist's signature, "Mildred Ford," is inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Lantern
